instruction: Please enable HTTPS-First mode in Chrome to always use secure connections when available.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling HTTPS-First mode in Chrome security settings. Custom getter get_chrome_https_only_mode__bef59d93 checks Chrome Preferences for https_first_mode_enabled in generated section and https_only_mode_enabled in profile. Returns 'true' when HTTPS-First mode is enabled.
metadata.verification: Custom getter verifies https_first_mode_enabled or https_only_mode_enabled is true in Chrome Preferences.
